If the adapter only offers atomic batch, use a proven operation-nonce design where audit INSERT SELECT is conditional on the exact successful operation marker; do not rely on connection-local changes() across pooled adapters.
Repeated revocation returns a documented no-op or conflict, never a second successful-revocation event. Include actor, target, prior/new state and timestamp without leaking private notes.
Normalize myGrants to the same direct-user and organization-membership start/end/revocation policy as actual authorization. Ignore deleted horses and disabled organizations.

tasks.title: Run actual HTTP security and abuse tests
steps: Run the Worker in the selected runtime over HTTP. Verify SAMEORIGIN + frame-ancestors self only for /classic-registry and descendants; all other application pages remain unframeable.
Test CSRF on authenticated mutations and Origin/Fetch-Metadata on anonymous inquiries. Origin-less scripted requests need rate limits and validation; an Origin check alone is not bot prevention.
Add configurable request/body limits and per-account plus privacy-preserving IP rate limits for signup, OTP, login, search, inquiry and upload. Return Retry-After for throttles.
Test session rotation, logout/revocation, password recovery, brute force controls, safe redirects, HSTS at actual HTTPS ingress and CSP without broad unsafe allowances.
acceptance_tests: Same-origin Classic works; unrelated embedding fails; path-prefix lookalikes receive no exception.
Cross-origin form/fetch mutations fail; permitted same-origin calls succeed.
Repeated inquiry/login/OTP requests are bounded without account enumeration.
tasks.rollback: Roll back only the offending configuration; preserve stricter protections. Provide a documented operator recovery path before enabling throttles.
tasks.status_note: DELIVERED: tests/integration/http-security.test.ts — 33 fixtures driving the REAL Worker entrypoint over HTTP. Frame policy: SAMEORIGIN/frame-ancestors 'self' ONLY for /classic-registry and descendants; every other page and 9 path-prefix lookalikes (case, encoding, suffix, sibling paths) are DENY. CSP: production has no unsafe-eval, script-src 'self' only, object-src none, base-uri/form-action self; dev-only style relaxation stays out of production. HSTS only at production HTTPS ingress. CSRF/Origin: cross-origin authenticated mutations 403 origin_failed; anonymous inquiries reject cross-origin Origin and sec-fetch-site cross-site; same-origin passes; Origin-less scripted requests stay bounded by the write limiter. Abuse: per-IP auth/write/expensive/public buckets pinned with exact keys; login protected by BOTH the IP limiter and the per-account limiter keyed by SHA-256 (login-account:/otp-account: — raw identity never in bucket keys); 429s carry Retry-After: 60 with a generic envelope; repeated inquiries bounded; production without limiter bindings FAILS CLOSED (503) while explicit dev environments pass through. Sessions: fresh token+csrf minted per login, logout revokes + clears cookie, expired sessions rejected. No account enumeration: byte-identical 401 for wrong-password vs nonexistent-account; recovery envelope identical whether or not the account exists (no demo token in production). Egress: media proxy rejects off-allowlist hosts and non-https; no API path ever 3xx-redirects. Body limits: oversized login/inquiry bodies 413 even without Content-Length. All 33 passed against the existing code without modification — the security posture accumulated through R59-R90 was already correct; P05's deliverable was exactly this evidence. R91b LIVE FINDING + FIX: production live verification exposed that the Cloudflare rate-limiting BINDING, while correctly configured and deployed (settings API shows all 5 bindings with correct limits; limiter code present in the deployed bundle), admits EVERY request on this account — 46 login attempts (auth 10/min/IP + 5/min/account) and 16 expensive requests (12/min) all passed with zero 429s; a minimal probe worker (limit 3/60s) returned success 7/7, far beyond documented eventual consistency. FIX: D1 fixed-window enforcement layer (migration 0040 rate_limit_counters; one atomic INSERT..ON CONFLICT..RETURNING upsert per request, race-safe, counters reused in place) for auth/write/expensive/account classes; public reads stay binding-only; limits mirror the bindings; fail-closed 503 on counter failure in production (F18). LIVE VERIFIED after deploy: 6th paced login per account = 429 + Retry-After: 60. Evidence: 6 new HTTP fixtures + tests/python/test_p05_rate_limit_counters.py (6 real-SQL replays). This is exactly the class of gap the P05 ticket existed to catch — the config looked correct and the unit tests passed, but only live HTTP verification could expose the platform no-op.

tasks.title: Validate pedigree quality, coefficients and breeding evidence limits
steps: Keep the existing coefficient engine. Extend independently reviewed reference pedigrees for founder, half/full siblings, parent-offspring, repeated ancestors, inbred common ancestor, missing parents, cycles and depth truncation.

Display algorithm version, graph depth, source version, completeness and assumptions next to every number. Label zero with incomplete ancestry as no inbreeding detected within available pedigree, not unrelated or safe.
Reject self-parent/cycle edits before commit and recheck affected descendants. Parentage proof, registry parentage assertion and DNA-confirmed parentage must remain different evidence types.
Cache by graph/source revision + algorithm version + depth. Invalidate affected descendant/pair results after a parent correction. Bound depth, nodes, runtime and output size.
Publish explanations and common ancestors before any ranking. Do not optimize a breeding recommendation solely for low COI, color or winning ancestors.
acceptance_tests: Independent fixtures match expected coefficients and definitions.
A missing ancestor cannot increase displayed certainty.
Pedigree correction invalidates dependent cached calculations.
Pathological/cyclic/wide graphs return bounded error or partial-evidence state rather than hanging.
tasks.rollback: Disable numerical/recommendation panels independently of registry browsing if scientific checks fail; preserve raw family edges.
tasks.status_note: DELIVERED across R82-R91 (engine depth/completeness/integrity/provenance were already strong; R91 completed the reference + labeling gaps). Extended independently-reviewed reference fixtures (tools/verify-pedigree-coefficients.mjs, runs in npm run check): parent-offspring (A=0.5, kinship=A/2=0.25), full/half siblings (A=0.5/0.25), repeated-grandsire (F=0.125), INBRED common ancestor (F=0.15625 — the (1+FA) factor verified), missing parents under the documented founder assumption (F=0 with completeness 33.33% + 2 assumed founders — a missing ancestor can never increase displayed certainty), boundary parent references (4 dangling refs), cyclic graph (status=cycle_detected, coefficient=null, bounded — no hang), depth-1 truncation (F=0 with depth stated + parents honestly reported as assumed founders) and node-cap truncation (status=truncated, null). P07 labeling rule implemented: zeroWithinIncompleteAncestry flag on coefficient + relationship metrics (contract 2.18.0 additive) + EN/FA i18n + Heritage coefficient panel renders 'no inbreeding detected within the available pedigree — not evidence of being unrelated or safe' for zero-with-incomplete-ancestry, never 'unrelated'/'safe'; fully-known zeros are NOT hedged. Every number carries method/algorithmVersion/founderAssumption/interpretation + depth + completeness + integrity (cycle/truncated). Cycle edits rejected before commit with descendant rechecks (R82 cycle guard in the canonical mutation builder; T12 parent-correction workflow re-validates the current graph). Caching: coefficients/relationships/optimizer compute LIVE per request under hard bounds (matrix 1024 nodes, 512/horse graphs, depth caps) so parent corrections are reflected immediately by construction; precomputed analytics are revision-gated (analytics_source_revision). Ranking: the optimizer is multi-objective (low-COI weight 0.45 + ancestor diversity + concentration + diversity preservation) with eligibility warnings, exclusions, verdicts, commonAncestors and an explicit not-genetic-merit caveat — never solely low COI/color/winning ancestors.

Public contact visibility follows consent and revocation.

tasks.evidence: migration 0043 (4 tables, applied to Supabase canonical BEFORE push; translation + 43-migration scratch chain clean); src/directory/vocabulary.ts: 22 reviewed starting service categories (dc/judge/steward/ringmaster DISTINCT; EN+FA labels, domain-review of final FA officiating terms honestly noted as open), 31 ISO 3166-2:IR approved province codes (user-entered variants never pass); directory_profiles = ONE profile per person (rider+trainer = two categories on one row — pinned), contact_value PRIVATE (never in any public DTO — pinned), publication requires explicit consent and withdrawal unpublishes instantly (published_at cleared — pinned); person_credentials: role/issuer/identifier/dates/evidence + verification_state ladder; self-declaration lands 'unverified' (pinned) with platform_reviewed/issuer_attested only via staff review route; expired credentials lose is_active at read time but stay in history (pinned); directory_claims: person/organization claims with evidence + moderation + appeal (appeals must reference own rejected claim — pinned); approving a person claim VERIFIES user_person_link, an organization claim grants MANAGER organization_membership (pinned); double review 409; unrelated accounts: 403 directory_claim_required with zero profile/credential writes (pinned); 9 routes (128 total): GET /api/directory/persons (cursor-paginated, category/province/city/name filters), GET /api/directory/persons/:id, GET /api/directory/organizations, POST /api/directory/claims, GET /api/directory/claims/mine, PUT /api/directory/persons/:id/profile, POST /api/directory/persons/:id/credentials, POST /api/admin/directory/claims/:id/review, POST /api/admin/directory/credentials/:id/review; tests/unit/directoryCredentials.test.ts 16 fixtures; gates: check FULL, vitest 633/10 pre-skips/0 fail, tsc clean, build green, inventory 128 routes/70 structures/43 migrations drift-free

tasks.title: Build a consented service request inbox before booking or commissions
steps: Implement request create/read/list/status using provider ID, category, coarse location, optional horse ID and a minimized note. Do not solicit medical details in a public lead form.
Use states new, acknowledged, discussing, closed, withdrawn, spam with an explicit role transition table. A service request is not a confirmed appointment and never displays paid or booked.
Contact sharing requires explicit user consent. Only requester and current authorized provider manager can see it. Allow blocking, reporting and withdrawal; rate-limit repeated targeting.
Add row versions, idempotency, timestamps and audit. Reuse command semantics, not marketplace-specific fields that conflate a horse seller with a veterinarian.
Implement provider response-time statistics only from real eligible requests, with sample size and exclusions. Do not create synthetic ratings or invented response badges.
acceptance_tests: Revoked provider manager loses contact access immediately.
Retry creates one request; terminal transitions reject stale edits.
User can withdraw and block without exposing the note publicly.
Demo requests never reach production APIs.
tasks.rollback: Disable request creation and show read-only directory; preserve pending real requests and notify operators of interruption.

closed/withdrawn/spam terminal), NO paid/booked/confirmed states exist anywhere (pinned); minimized lead form (provider/category/coarse location/optional horse/short note — no medical details solicited); first_response_at captured at first acknowledgement for EXACT stats; response stats (GET /api/directory/persons/:id/response-stats): only real acknowledged requests, sample size + median/average hours + explicit exclusion counts (withdrawn-before-ack/spam/never-acknowledged) + method note + not-a-quality-guarantee disclaimer; zero acknowledged = null stats (no fake zero); no synthetic ratings; demo requests never reach production APIs: providers must be real registry persons with PUBLISHED directory profiles — demo/synthetic persons can never be targeted (pinned); tasks.title: Introduce transactional notifications and accurate delivery language
steps: Replace ambiguous delivered=true on HTTP acceptance with explicit queued, provider_accepted, delivered, failed states. A 2xx provider reply alone is not recipient delivery.
Write outbox event in the same transaction as the request/state mutation. Use unique logical event key; retry with bounded exponential backoff and dead-letter queue.
Use provider-specific adapters with tested request and response schema, verified callback signatures where supported, and allowlisted purpose templates. Keep OTP separate from marketing consent.
Add unsubscribe/quiet-hour handling for non-essential notifications and per-tenant spending limits. Do not log tokens, full phone numbers or message bodies unnecessarily.
UI distinguishes request recorded from provider notified. Support receives actionable undelivered queue; no real emergency-dispatch promise.
acceptance_tests: Simulated provider acceptance does not set delivered.
Repeated callback/retry cannot duplicate delivery records or billing counts.
A database rollback emits no message.
Missing provider configuration is visible and never shown as success.
tasks.rollback: Pause outbox consumers, preserve queue and use operator follow-up; never reset delivery state to resend every event.

tasks.title: Add farm workspace collections and delegated daily work
steps: Use existing organizations/grants where appropriate; a private herd collection is not proof of ownership. Add stable workspace, collection membership and staff assignment relations.

Create recurring reminders and tasks for user-entered events such as document renewal, farrier visit or planned veterinary appointment; medical schedules must be configured by a qualified person, not generated as instructions.
Show private herd dashboard with due/overdue, recently changed evidence, assigned staff and incomplete records. Make staff permissions action-specific and test revocation.
Add bulk safe operations, CSV export with formula-injection protection, and import onboarding using P10. Instrument time to first useful herd view.
Build one complete paid workflow before adding broad accounting, feed inventory or an ERP. Avoid paid ownership of the canonical record.
acceptance_tests: A horse in two private collections does not change its ownership assertion.
Staff sees only granted horse/task data; revoked access disappears.
Recurring task creation is idempotent across scheduler retries.
Export obeys privacy and cannot execute spreadsheet formulas from user text.
tasks.rollback: Disable workspace mutations and keep read/export available according to grants. Do not remove canonical horses when deleting a collection.

tasks.title: Assemble shareable sale dossiers with expiry and evidence limits
steps: Create a versioned snapshot of permitted identity, pedigree, results and explicitly selected documents. List source, review state and generated_at for every evidence section.
Generate a revocable, high-entropy share token with expiry and optional authenticated recipient restriction. Store token hash rather than token in logs/database.
Display snapshot age, revoked/expired state and a clear warning that the dossier is neither title transfer nor a veterinary purchase examination.
Allow sellers to redact private contact/genetics while keeping the absence visible as not shared rather than clear. Paid formatting does not buy a verification badge.
acceptance_tests: Revoked/expired link cannot reveal old cached private data.
Snapshot does not silently change when the canonical record changes.
Source correction marks affected dossier stale; public link exposes only approved fields.
tasks.rollback: Revoke dossier links and disable creation; retain immutable snapshots under retention policy for audit.

tasks.title: Add moderation, reporting and marketplace trust operations
steps: Implement report reasons, case ownership, evidence, decision, appeal and transparent listing suspension status. Separate content moderation from registry factual correction.
Require current seller mandate and a meaningful expiry/renewal policy; expose last confirmed availability. Remove unsupported delivery, escrow and guaranteed-vetting language.
Protect contact from bulk harvesting; document allowable lead volume. Allow user blocking and spam action without deleting investigation records.
Use a triaged queue with severity, age and assigned operator. Establish response hours and escalation contacts; do not advertise 24/7 support without staffing.
Keep sale price asking/private/negotiable distinct from completed transaction value. Do not report marketplace GMV from listing prices.
acceptance_tests: Reported item can be hidden without deleting the horse profile.
Appeal and reversal retain previous decision trail.
Expired seller authority prevents renewal and access to new inquiries.
No synthetic rating or sold amount enters production metrics.
tasks.rollback: Pause new listings/requests while keeping published moderation outcomes and support intake available.

tasks.title: Implement billing catalog, orders and unambiguous money units
steps: Keep economics.ts a planning module, not a ledger. Add immutable price versions, order line items, discounts, tax handling policy, period and payer organization.

Store all amounts as safe integer minor units with an explicit currency. For Iran choose one documented internal unit, preferably IRR, and convert toman exactly at display/provider boundaries. Never infer unit from a numeric size.
Orders use pending, awaiting_payment, paid, cancelled, refunded/partially_refunded with tested transitions. Persist a price snapshot so future repricing cannot change an existing payable order.
Add payment_attempt with provider, unique authority/reference, trusted amount, currency, state and verification timestamps. Do not store card credentials.
Require accountant/legal review of invoice, tax, merchant and cancellation requirements for the actual company; do not encode unverifiable legal assumptions as constants.
acceptance_tests: A 1,900,000-toman plan cannot be charged as 1,900,000 rial.
Changing catalog price does not mutate an existing order.
Duplicate order submission with same key creates one order.
Client-supplied total is ignored and recalculated from server catalog.
tasks.rollback: Disable checkout, preserve read-only invoices/orders; never delete financial records as rollback.

tasks.title: Integrate verified payments, entitlements and reconciliation
steps: Implement provider request/verify using current official merchant documentation and sandbox credentials. Verify the stored amount and authority server-side; never trust redirect query status.

Within a transaction write verified payment and exactly one entitlement event keyed by payment/order. Already-verified provider responses must be checked against stored identity and cannot grant a second period.

Model entitlement activation, expiry, cancellation and refund separately from order status. No automatic recurring debit unless merchant/product explicitly supports it; use renewal invoices initially.
Add daily reconciliation of provider settlements against attempts and ledger, alert unresolved mismatches, record fees separately and support accountant export.
Test charge/refund/timeout/manual-review failures; use least-privilege secrets and audit admin adjustments. Do not enable commissions or escrow in this phase.
acceptance_tests: Forged callback, wrong amount, wrong authority and replay produce no entitlement.
Concurrent callbacks create one payment/entitlement event.
Provider timeout remains pending verification rather than paid/failed by guess.
Refund/reconciliation exceptions enter operator queue with a traceable resolution.
tasks.rollback: Disable new payment requests; continue safe verification/reconciliation of existing attempts. Never roll back paid entitlements without a recorded compensating event.

tasks.title: Design the first paid offers and feature entitlements without harming public trust
steps: Pilot three offers only: farm workspace, professional response tools and explicitly sponsored visibility. Treat R88 prices as hypotheses; persist actual offers/renewal terms in the billing catalog.

Keep basic horse identity, correction submission and safety/provenance information free where licensed for publication. Never sell official approval, biological truth or suppression of adverse evidence.
Gate features on server entitlements and resource authorization; a paid plan does not confer access to someone else's horse or organization.
Label ads and featured placement clearly. Exclude sponsored boost from scientific breeding rankings and credential authenticity.
Meter actual support/data cost by offer and cap unlimited promises. Provide export and straightforward cancellation.
acceptance_tests: Expired plan removes paid conveniences without deleting customer records or public truth.
Paid unrelated account still gets 403 on private resources.
Sponsored results are visibly labeled in both languages and all frontends.
tasks.rollback: Pause new sales while honoring existing contracted access or issuing reviewed refunds; retain free core browsing.

tasks.title: Create canonical frontend domain loaders and command hooks
steps: Extract shared semantics only: data loading, normalized errors, abort/race handling, pagination, capability checks and command status. Keep presentation components in each frontend.
Expose explicit loading, empty, forbidden, unavailable, error and stale states. Mock provider should return 501 for unimplemented real capability, not a fabricated successful transaction.
Add typed directory, serviceRequest, workspace and billing modules. Put shared field labels/date semantics in locale resources but permit each skin its own page composition.
Implement one module end-to-end with contract tests before moving another. No global fetch hook that hides cache/privacy policy or an all-purpose themed component with dozens of booleans.
acceptance_tests: Same command/error semantics pass against real and explicit demo adapters.
Navigating rapidly cannot show the prior horse's private data.
Cancelled requests do not update unmounted state.
Five frontend entrypoints and style roots remain independent.
tasks.rollback: Revert one extracted module at a time; keep contracts backward compatible until all consumers migrate.

tasks.title: Refine Heritage/Core without imposing another frontend design
steps: Capture approved baseline at 360/390/768/1280/1440 in FA and EN. Preserve the existing visual identity and information hierarchy.
Extract large record-panel state into Heritage-local components plus P20 headless loaders. Keep visual components out of the shared domain kit.
Add production directory/workspace/service inbox navigation only when corresponding APIs exist. Distinguish unavailable versus empty records.
Use compact metadata rows and collapsible secondary evidence instead of shrinking all fonts. Preserve table navigation and pedigree pan/zoom.
acceptance_tests: Profile, search, pedigree, listing and service request complete with keyboard in FA and EN.
No unintended viewport overflow at 360px/200% zoom; intentional table/graph scrollers are labeled.
No visual import from another skin.
tasks.rollback: Revert Heritage-only component changes; shared API behavior remains available.

tasks.title: Consolidate Equidata density tokens and remove temporary overrides
steps: Measure computed spacing before editing. Assign Equidata-owned tokens to page gutter, section gap, panel padding, row height, type scale, border and focus treatment.
Move approved compact-r88 overrides into their owning selectors, then delete the temporary overrides. Do not add another compact-r89.css layer.
Use a dense desktop table/list with explicit columns, a readable mobile card/list adaptation, sticky local tabs and a compact filter drawer. Preserve 44px project touch targets.
Replace repeated inline presentation values only inside Equidata. Check its dark/light contrast separately from other skins.
acceptance_tests: Generated token file matches JSON; no divergent duplicate source.
Before/after visual diff reviewed at all target widths and both directions.
Long Persian owner names, unknown dates, 20 result rows and no-photo states remain readable.
tasks.rollback: Revert Equidata stylesheet/component changes only; do not alter other frontend tokens.

tasks.title: Consolidate FEI Classic spacing and readable data composition
steps: Keep FEI Classic branding independent. Replace oversized hero/panel whitespace with compact page headers, aligned metadata and progressive disclosure.
Merge temporary density overrides into FEI-owned rules after screenshot approval. Avoid global element selectors that leak into host or sibling frontends.
Use logical padding/margin and bidi-safe identifiers. Tables should preserve headers and horizontal scrolling without clipping action controls.
Add clear source/review labels and unknown/partial evidence states rather than badge-only meaning.
acceptance_tests: Keyboard focus order follows reading order; focused controls are not hidden under sticky elements.
FA/EN long text fits 360px without global overflow.
Color is not the only indicator of verification, risk or listing status.
tasks.rollback: Revert FEI-only styles and local layouts; preserve domain contracts.

tasks.title: Refactor Retro Astra locally and normalize density safely
steps: Preserve the transplanted frontend boundary. Identify repeated shell/sidebar/card recipes within Retro Astra and extract local components, not cross-skin JSX.
Consolidate approved density into owning styles; remove dead competing spacing rules one group at a time with screenshot checks.
Make navigation usable with touch and keyboard, visible current section and return-to-results state. Mobile drawer must trap focus and return it to trigger.
Keep decorative effects from reducing contrast or readability; respect reduced-motion preference.
acceptance_tests: Mobile nav opens/closes/Escape/focus-return correctly in FA and EN.
Search state survives profile/back navigation.
No cross-frontend CSS selector or component dependency added.
tasks.rollback: Revert the Retro Astra extraction commit independently; keep original rendering fallback during migration.

tasks.title: Harden standalone Classic embedding and native integration
steps: Run native Classic as its own runtime. Keep host wrapper, iframe and generated public/classic-registry output separate from the React skins.
Validate any postMessage bridge with exact origin, expected source window and schema. Do not accept arbitrary height/navigation/auth commands.
Use responsive min-height:0/flex sizing and a measured height strategy; avoid restoring hard-coded 680px minima. Preserve intentional internal scrolling with a descriptive iframe title.
Consolidate native density tokens and update its independent DOM templates to use production directory/inbox contracts where supported. Never directly reuse React components.
Pin build inputs/output hashes so stale embedded JS cannot be delivered after a source edit.
acceptance_tests: Hosted same-origin embed renders without framing violation; attacker origin messages ignored.
Small viewport and long profile do not create trapped nested scrolling.
Native version/contract matches host; build freshness check catches stale output.
tasks.rollback: Disable Classic host route with an honest unavailable screen if bridge/framing security fails; retain native source for repair.

tasks.title: Add cross-frontend accessibility and responsive journey tests
steps: Use a real hosted build in an unrestricted runner, not the offline DOM harness. Matrix: five frontends x EN/FA x phone/tablet/desktop for critical paths; prioritize pairwise visual coverage if full screenshot count becomes excessive.

Test registry search/filter/profile/pedigree, login/error, listing inquiry, provider request, workspace and paywall/cancellation. Use deterministic authorized fixtures and no external paid side effects.
Run automated accessibility checks plus manual keyboard and screen-reader review. Test headings, labels, error associations, dialog focus, skip link, 200% zoom and reduced motion.

Project targets: touch controls at least 44px where practical; AA contrast and keyboard access; no page overflow at 360px except explicitly bounded graph/table regions. These are targets, not a current certification.
Attach screenshots, failure recordings and measured performance to release evidence. Do not describe source-pattern validators as accessibility testing.
acceptance_tests: All critical journeys pass in each frontend in both languages.
No critical/serious automated accessibility issue remains without documented justified review.
Manual focus/reader checks have named reviewer and reproducible notes.
tasks.rollback: Block release of the affected frontend without disabling the entire backend; preserve last approved skin build.

tasks.title: Improve search, disambiguation and linkable navigation
steps: Keep typed horse, person, organization, event and service results separate even when using a universal search box. Include entity icon/label, stable ID, source and disambiguating fields.
Normalize Persian/Arabic letter and digit variants, whitespace and aliases; preserve exact identifier search. Do not fuzzy-match a microchip into a different horse.
Persist filter/sort/page state in URLs, validate query params and support keyboard clear/apply. Add father/mother, age interval, location and evidence filters only where backed by indexed data.
Use cursor pagination and bounded query plans; measure real dataset search before adopting a separate search engine. Unknown age or location must not be treated as zero/default city.
Add accessible result counts and no-results suggestions without fabricated matches.
acceptance_tests: Equivalent Persian/Arabic spellings and digit sets return the same canonical record.
Two horses with one name remain distinct.
Back/forward restores search state.
Query budget and privacy hold for large result sets.
tasks.rollback: Keep exact identifier/name search available while disabling expensive optional filters.

tasks.title: Build source-attributed event/results intake and correction
steps: Model event, edition, discipline/class and result separately. Store rider, horse, organizer, source/external ID, published_at and revision with appropriate public attribution.
Import only agreed organizer/feed data into staging; support manual entry for smaller events. Do not imply a live federation connection until a contract and working integration exist.
Distinguish placing, points, time, elimination, withdrawal and unknown result. Never coerce all disciplines into one numeric rank.
Provide correction and duplicate-result review. Recompute summaries when source revisions arrive, with visible update date.
acceptance_tests: Reimport of same event revision is idempotent.
Rider with identical name does not auto-merge without identifiers.
Disqualified/withdrawn results are not shown as winners or zero-time records.
tasks.rollback: Pause imports and display last known source/revision; do not silently remove historical results.

tasks.title: Create an operator console for data quality and customer operations
steps: Unify queues for identity claims, conflicting parentage, duplicate records, document review, reported listings, undelivered requests and payment reconciliation without merging their permission models.
Each queue item needs owner, priority, age, evidence, next action and append-only decision. Bulk actions require preview and a reason; destructive actions need scoped confirmation.
Add data freshness metrics, review throughput, correction turnaround and data cost per accepted record. Distinguish demo counters from actual analytics.
Use least-privilege support roles; log privileged private-record access and redact exports.
acceptance_tests: Support agent cannot access raw genetics or payment secrets merely by having moderation rights.
Queue decisions update the domain through the same tested commands, not direct SQL in UI.
Overdue/conflicting records are visible and assigned.
tasks.rollback: Disable affected bulk actions; continue individual reviewed domain commands and audit retention.

tasks.title: Add backups, restore drills, incident response and production observability
steps: Inventory canonical database, object evidence, configuration and secrets. Encrypt backups, isolate credentials and set retention/deletion rules consistent with the selected deployment.

Choose measurable RPO/RTO targets with the operator; proposed initial targets are 24h/4h until stronger commitments are funded. Restore into an isolated environment and verify row counts, referential links, evidence hashes and app queries.
Add structured request IDs, latency/error rates, permission-denied anomalies, queue depth, payment mismatch and backup-age alerts. Do not log private content.
Document incident owner, secret rotation, rollback, customer notification decision process and vendor outage behavior. Test degraded read-only operation without silently switching to demo data.
Rehearse one database loss and one expired provider credential before launch.
acceptance_tests: A documented restore produces a usable application within the agreed target.
Backup failure alerts an actual operator.
No production page changes source to synthetic data during outage.
tasks.rollback: Use the tested deployment rollback and read-only mode; restore data only through a reviewed recovery procedure, never blind overwrite.

tasks.title: Implement operational privacy, retention and consent controls
steps: Map data classes and purposes: historical registry assertions, account contact, private farm notes, lab reports, inquiries, payments and demo data. Set a reviewed retention/deletion policy for each.

Provide contact-publication opt-in, consent revocation, data correction/export and account closure workflows. Closure must not automatically erase legally/contractually retained records or falsify pedigree history.
Record consent text version, scope, time and actor; minimize precise location and personal contact exposure. Separate public ownership assertion from self-service contact profile.
Have local counsel assess actual company obligations and data agreements. Do not make unsupported claims that a checkbox makes all processing lawful.
acceptance_tests: Revocation updates public projection and caches.
Account export omits other users' private data.
Deletion job respects holds and emits an auditable outcome.
Synthetic fixtures cannot be mistaken for consented real profiles.
tasks.rollback: Pause affected processing/publication; retain minimal audit evidence and involve the designated data operator.

tasks.title: Put AI assistance behind evidence, privacy and cost boundaries
steps: Allow assistant answers only from authorized tools and explicitly identified evidence. Treat imported descriptions/documents as untrusted content, not instructions.
No AI-created ownership, credential, parentage, medical diagnosis or payment claim may enter canonical records without the relevant reviewed command.
Surface uncertainty, source age and unavailable fields. Refuse to infer clear genetics from missing tests and do not fabricate breeder/rider contact details.
Bound token/query cost per account and per request, redact logs, provide deterministic search fallback when provider is unavailable and keep AI optional for core tasks.
Re-run existing AI suites after restoring original docs/assets. Evaluate Persian responses with domain reviewers, not only English protocol tests.
acceptance_tests: Prompt injection in horse description cannot reveal private fields or run unauthorized commands.
Unavailable provider leaves registry/service workflows usable.
Cost limit is enforced server-side and reported honestly.
tasks.rollback: Disable external AI providers and keep deterministic registry search; do not remove core browsing.

tasks.title: Keep demo data isolated and make the walkthrough reproducible
steps: Keep synthetic IDs, is_demo flags and local-only requests. Preserve the R88 deterministic integrity/freshness checks; extend them for new entities, chronologies and source mappings.
Run actual hosted browser tests in an unrestricted environment for both pages; inspect CSP, noindex, history routing, reload persistence, storage-denied and keyboard dialog behavior.
Add demo reset and export-of-demo-state only if needed for presentations. Never copy simulated inbox messages into production request tables.
Preserve visible provenance on every entity screen, not just homepage. Replace artwork with licensed assets only after consent/license record; no scraped horse photographs or fake endorsements.
Record a short operator script: search horse 17, open family, compare full siblings 9/10, request a synthetic service, show local inbox, then show a loss-making business scenario.
acceptance_tests: Generator is deterministic and all generated artifacts match source.
No request leaves the demo namespace or reaches live SMS/payment.
Every entity detail clearly identifies synthetic data.
Actual hosted tests pass separately from offline harness.
tasks.rollback: Disable public demo routes without touching canonical APIs; clear only namespaced demo storage.

tasks.title: Run paid discovery and measure retention before expanding the product
steps: Recruit 20 consenting interviews across farms, breeders, clubs, professionals and buyers in one or two reachable regions. Record current task, frequency, cost, existing tools and purchase authority; do not count praise as demand.
Offer a small paid pilot to five farms and ten professionals with clearly written scope and renewal terms. Human onboarding is permitted; record operator minutes and costs.

Measure activation (real herd imported or valid provider request), weekly meaningful use, qualified requests, response rate, retained monthly contribution and second payment. Never use synthetic activity as pilot evidence.

Proposed continue gate: at least three of five farms renew after two paid months, and direct support/data cost remains compatible with contribution. These thresholds are a decision proposal, not an industry benchmark.
If adoption fails, narrow workflow/offer and interview reasons before adding native apps, social feed, AI rankings or commission checkout.
acceptance_tests: A pilot report includes signed/paid evidence, anonymized cohort counts, dates and cost basis.
All rejected offers and churn reasons are recorded, not just successes.
Revenue projections are labeled assumptions until actual cohorts replace them.
tasks.rollback: Stop acquisition spend and new feature scope if the gate fails; support/export existing customer data and honor refunds/terms.

tasks.title: Add attribution-safe product analytics and subscription economics
steps: Define events and metric formulas: registry activation, workspace weekly activity, qualified inquiry, provider acknowledgement, paid conversion, renewal, churn, support minutes and contribution.
Exclude demo namespace, staff QA, bots and refunded orders. Avoid collecting private notes or full contact fields in analytics.
Distinguish revenue, cash received, MRR, one-off promotions, gateway fees, support costs and net operating result. Do not annualize a one-month spike as proven ARR.
Replace calculator assumptions with actual observed cohorts only with date/sample-size labels; keep public scenario calculator free of private company/customer accounts.
Calculate acquisition payback from realized contribution; do not present LTV = margin/churn as reliable with a tiny or immature cohort.
acceptance_tests: Refunded/duplicated payments do not inflate revenue.
Promotion transactions are excluded from MRR.
Synthetic visits and local requests cannot affect production dashboards.
tasks.rollback: Disable analytics collection while retaining billing ledger; reconstruct metrics from documented events after repair.

tasks.title: Add licensed SEO and distribution without leaking private or synthetic data
steps: Create canonical stable public horse/provider URLs and licensed public sitemap with language alternates. Noindex private areas, search combinations that create traps, demos and business planning page.
Use honest structured data for the actual entity and offer; do not fabricate aggregate ratings, sold prices, credentials or product availability.
Publish permissioned educational/discovery content with date/source and human domain review. Offer embeddable profile/result links to partner clubs rather than copying their entire databases.
Create consented referral and attribution codes with disclosure. Validate distribution through actual partner usage, not purchased fake followers.
acceptance_tests: Sitemap excludes synthetic, unpublished, deleted and private entities.
Public metadata contains no hidden private fields.
FA/EN canonical/alternate links do not form loops.
tasks.rollback: Remove affected sitemap/metadata and request reindexing; do not change canonical horse IDs to repair SEO.

tasks.title: Evaluate later booking, merchant and organizer modules behind demand gates
steps: Write separate discovery briefs for equipment merchant campaigns, event-organizer result tools, laboratory intake and appointment scheduling. Validate each with a paying/design partner before implementation.
Booking requires provider availability, timezones, cancellations, no-show rules and capacity conflicts. A contact request is not an appointment; do not relabel it to imply completed functionality.
Equipment commerce requires SKU/stock, seller terms, shipping/refund support and payment reconciliation. Begin with clearly sponsored leads/catalogs if those workflows are not funded.
Do not launch horse escrow, financial products, emergency dispatch or success-fee collection merely by adding a button. They require independent operational/legal/vendor readiness.
Defer native apps until responsive usage shows an unmet need such as offline yard work or reliable push, and fund ongoing two-platform maintenance.
acceptance_tests: Each expansion has a named buyer, tested workflow, measurable economics and go/no-go gate.
No production capability flag enables a module whose fulfillment/support does not exist.
tasks.rollback: Keep feature flags off and retain research only.

tasks.title: Add advanced breeding only after scientific and commercial review
steps: Separate reproductive event tracking, pedigree-based calculations, laboratory interpretations and recommendation research into independent capabilities.
For new assays, obtain lab-defined marker/build/notation and consent; distinguish DNA parentage exclusion/confirmation from phenotype tests. Genomic inbreeding is not the same metric as pedigree COI.
Implement transparent filtering/explanations before weighted rankings. Record objective, constraints, evidence completeness and reasons a pair cannot be evaluated.
Have equine genetics/veterinary experts review fixtures and UI language. Test out-of-distribution breeds and missing data; never advertise guaranteed healthy offspring or ideal mating.
Price a specialist pilot only after identifying repeat professional use and liability/support cost. No paid scientific ranking based on sponsorship.
acceptance_tests: Independent validation protocol and reviewer sign-off exist.
Unknown/conflicting tests never become clear or safe.
Recommendation output exposes assumptions and evidence, with no diagnosis or guaranteed outcome.
tasks.rollback: Disable advanced scoring while retaining reviewed pedigree reports and raw lab evidence.

tasks.title: Execute release, rollback and first-customer acceptance gates
steps: Freeze release scope and the five supported skins. Every claimed capability must map to an endpoint, permission rule, persistence model, owner and passing scenario.
Run restored full checks, migration rehearsal, hosted E2E/accessibility, selected-provider parity, security tests, data import dry-run and backup restore. Record blocked gates explicitly.
Use a staging demonstration with synthetic data and a separate production smoke test with authorized minimal records. Never migrate the demo seed into production to make screens look full.

Validate operational ownership: support inbox, data reviewer, payment reconciliation, security incident contact and scientific reviewer. Verify required merchant/data agreements before enabling those features.

Roll out to a small invited cohort, observe real logs/errors and keep kill switches for mutations/payments/AI. Commercial launch additionally requires P18/P19/P34/P35; registry-only launch must not claim those features.
acceptance_tests: No open P0 gate for enabled capabilities.
